pages.useful_because: The homepage tells a Plymouth property owner, before they call, what actually moves an excavation price on their lot: which ground conditions (sand and gravel, clay and old fill, ledge) change equipment and schedule, and which three approvals can apply (the Dig Safe 811 notice with its 72-hour rule, Plymouth Conservation Commission review near wetlands, Plymouth Board of Health septic inspections). It also lays out BDPM Site Services' four-step job sequence and points home sellers to booking the Title 5 inspection before listing. None of that is on a generic competitor homepage.
